title: Fourth V4 checkpoint: narrow CFR development perplexity
description: Five observations on the same 7,057-label CFR development set. Stage-local completed valid labels and perplexities: repeated parent baseline 0, 39.776214231484126; checkpoint 569 at 18,604,156, 39.4729645509789; checkpoint 1,137 at 37,175,835, 38.51235059861212; checkpoint 1,705 at 55,747,334, 38.54555845078176; checkpoint 2,273 at 74,319,147, 38.17367341486999. The small regression at checkpoint 1,705 is preserved. Hollow circle is the repeated parent baseline, not a new checkpoint. The y-axis is restricted to show small changes. Repeated development evaluation is not sealed holdout or evidence of transferable logic.
